From: Megan Cole <megan@elarahealth.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@elarahealth.com
Subject: Elara / Redwood — MSA redlines and onboarding checkpoint

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. We reviewed the MSA with Legal and Procurement this morning and attached our consolidated redlines (Elara_MSA_Redlines_v2.pdf). A couple of asks from our side: 1) a quick call to walk the redlines so we can prioritize which points need legal alignment vs. operational notes, and 2) a short mutual action plan (MAP) so both teams have a clear onboarding timeline.

Availability from our side:
- Mon 16 Nov: 10:00–12:00 PT or 15:00–17:00 PT
- Tue 17 Nov: 09:00–11:00 PT

If those don't work, we can be flexible later the same week. Can you confirm who from Redwood should join? We expect Legal + Procurement on our call (I've cc'd procurement@elarahealth.com).

Appreciate it — hoping to lock a 30–45m sync and the MAP ahead of the pilot kickoff.

Best,
Megan
Megan Cole
Senior Procurement Manager, Elara Health
Attachment: Elara_MSA_Redlines_v2.pdf (pdf, 42 KB)

Hi Megan — thanks for sending the packet and availability. We can absolutely do a redline walk and put a MAP together.

Suggested 30–45m slots (Redwood attendees: me + Laura Bennett (Legal) + Ben Carter (Customer Success)):
- Mon 16 Nov 10:30–11:15 PT
- Mon 16 Nov 15:30–16:15 PT
- Tue 17 Nov 09:30–10:15 PT

If Mon 10:30 works, we'll share a MAP draft ahead of the call (I'll include an initial rollout timeline and the list of items we'll mark as \"legal decision\" vs \"operational\" so your team can prioritize). Also attaching a MAP template we typically use (Redwood_MAP_Draft.xlsx).

Confirm whichever slot you prefer and we'll send a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Sales — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Laura, can you review the attached Elara_MSA_Redlines_v2.pdf and flag any must-have legal items we should prepare language for ahead of the call? If possible, please pull a short list (<=5 items) that require executive sign-off vs. negotiable terms we can accept for the pilot. Ben / Hannah — I'll lean on you for the MAP assumptions (pilot scope, data residency, SSO timeline).

Proposed: lock Mon 16 Nov 10:30 PT for a 45m session and have Legal call out top questions in the first 15m so Procurement can triage. I'll draft the calendar invite and include the MAP link.

Quick notes for the call prep: 
- Laura: confirm any non-starters and suggested redline language before Monday EOD (Pacific).
- Ben: draft pilot success criteria and a short timeline (1–3 slides).
- Hannah: prep SSO and data-retention bullets we can drop into the MAP.

Thanks team — try to keep this tight; Elara is on a fast timeline for a Q1 pilot.

— Rishi
